description:
User explicitly approved RAM-only Mnesia on 2026-10-13 after discussion of restart message-decryption risk. No disk state, checkpoints or replication. Preserve existing unrelated BO worktree edits. No Git mutations authorized.
Policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md, docs/services/engine.md; docs/documentation.md before docs edits.
Architecture: Channels owns profile-scoped Mnesia ram_copies table; only session and sender_key namespaces are volatile. Pairing creds and other protocol records remain encrypted through Engine. Keep per-call confidential Engine binding validation for RAM access. User approves loss on node/Mnesia restart; listener restart retains RAM state. No new UI; no new E2E required.
Own LinkedDevice.Storage, LinkedDevice listener preparation, Session confirmation handoff and Engine CredentialDocuments generic delete_namespace extension. Existing get/put/delete/list_keys callbacks route only session/sender_key to Mnesia after existing Engine binding check. Clear clears both stores. Startup deletes legacy volatile namespaces via existing credential_document Action extended with atomic delete_namespace; other namespaces preserved. Freeze and filter snapshot before confirm_linked_device; seed volatile snapshot once only after durable confirmation and before runtime start. Persistence success plus RAM/start failure is saved/runtime_pending, never failed save. Tests first: RAM writes don't change grant ciphertext or enqueue notifications; revoked/disabled/forged bindings fail; cleanup and profile isolation; legacy removal idempotent; seed handoff and retry don't overwrite advanced state; pairing survives independent node RAM loss. Action reuse: extend existing credential_document Action/domain op delete_namespace (existing clear too broad and per-key deletes non-atomic); same confidential trusted-runtime authorization and Connect encryption/notification transaction. Reuse confirm_linked_device, no new Action. Extend callback infrastructure locally for RAM storage.

comments.text: Implemented hybrid adapter, current-binding checks, legacy namespace removal through extended existing Action, and post-confirmation RAM seeding. Session writes leave grants and notification jobs unchanged. Found and fixed late snapshot rollback/resurrection risk by retaining a seeded tombstone after writes/deletes/clear. mix q passed; 61 tests and 5 properties passed across linked-device and Engine document suites.

title: [zaq-0l7.13.2] Route messaging sessions to RAM and preserve durable pairing
